# #14 Code copy — blind adversarial QA

**Verdict: PASS** (no blocker or major defects). Implementation diff and src/ were not read.

## Gate (frozen tests)
- `VERIFY_ITEMS=14 E2E_FILES=items/14-code-copy.test.mjs,app.test.mjs,tripleclick-selection.test.mjs,mermaid.test.mjs scripts/verify.sh --only typecheck,unit,build,e2e`:
  typecheck PASS, unit 385/385, build PASS, e2e/14-code-copy 19/19, tripleclick 3/3, mermaid 4/4, **app 3/33 FAIL**.
  The app failures were all `waitForFixture` timeouts on `doc-title` "fixture.md"; `tests/e2e/app.test.mjs` was edited by another agent during the run (it now waits for "Test Document").
- Rerun: `VERIFY_ITEMS=14 E2E_FILES=app.test.mjs scripts/verify.sh --only e2e` gave **app 50/50 PASS** (run 20261010-212914). Not a #14 issue.

## Own driver
`.verify/qa/14/qa.mjs`, `probe.mjs`, `probe2.mjs`, run with `scripts/lib/browser-slot.sh scripts/lib/stack.sh run -- node …`. Chromium had real clipboard permissions, and copies were read back with `navigator.clipboard.readText()`. Screenshots are in `.verify/qa/14/*.png`.

|---|---|---|

| 14.2 | PASS | typescript block copy equals the source. It has no markup, and the label word does not leak |

## Edge cases
All PASS:
- Copy round-trips exactly for:
  - `</code></pre><script>… &amp;` literal text
  - an empty block (copies "", shows Copied)
  - emoji, ZWJ, RTL, NBSP, a tab, trailing spaces and blank lines
  - fences inside a list item, a blockquote, a `[!NOTE]` callout and `<details>`
  - a 5,000-line block (~97 ms including the click)
- CRLF source copies `line1\nline2`.
- An info string of `"><script>` and one of `<img>` render as escaped literal text, and no script runs.
- `navigator.clipboard` undefined: the execCommand fallback copies the exact text and leaves no textarea behind.
- A rapid double-click copies, starts no selection and shows no bar.
- Copy while the action bar is open: the copy succeeds and the bar closes.
- `comment-highlight` on the `pre`: the toolbar bottom is 16 px above the first line and the highlight is kept (`desktop-highlight.png`).
- Theme toggle while "Copied" is showing: the state is kept, no errors.
- A long line scrolls inside the `pre` (overflow-x auto) and the toolbar stays put (`desktop-long.png`).
- An HTML doc shows 0 copy buttons in any frame.
- The `button[type=button]` aria-labels are "Copy bash code" and "Copy code". Desktop hit area is 80×32.

## Defects
None at blocker, major or minor severity.

Notes (not defects):
- Read-mode shared docs open no selection action bar even on plain paragraphs. That is existing behaviour, not #14.
- #19 export is not landed, so rule 13 could not be checked.
- The print check used computed style. The PDF (`print.pdf`) was produced but could not be rendered on this box because poppler is missing.
